unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U20: Select the remedy,limitation article and start event before computing a deadline

payload.title: A limitation decision begins with the legal claim
payload.core_explanation_md:
Identify whether the proposed proceeding is a suit, appeal or application, then the relevant article and triggering event. The period is not selected simply because a file contains a loan. Money lent, money deposited on demand, an instalment obligation, mortgage enforcement and decree execution can use different starting rules. The book table should not be copied as a universal three-year shortcut.

Section3 makes limitation relevant even where the opposing party has not raised it. A missing defence plea does not cure an otherwise late proceeding. Mutual-account treatment also requires the actual reciprocal-demand facts; calling a ledger current account is not sufficient to establish every legal condition.

self_check.prompt_text: Can the absence of a limitation defence itself make a late suit timely?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The statutory limitation duty remains relevant.

payload.stem_md: A bank selects a deadline solely because its spreadsheet calls the account current. What additional analysis is needed?

options.explanation_md: Formatting does not establish the applicable article.

options.text_md: The legal nature of the claim, reciprocal-demand facts and applicable trigger
options.explanation_md: Account labels cannot replace the statutory test.

options.text_md: A rule that every account has the same start date
options.explanation_md: Different claims can have distinct triggers.
Software preference does not define limitation.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Account labels cannot replace the statutory test.

payload.stem_md: The defendant has not pleaded limitation. A late-filing review proposes to ignore it for that reason alone. What does section 3 require?

options.text_md: The parties can automatically remove the statutory rule by silence
options.explanation_md: Silence does not establish a statutory exception.

options.text_md: Every claim becomes a mortgage suit
options.explanation_md: The claim character does not change.

options.text_md: A new cause of action is invented on filing day
Check the prescribed period despite the missing defence plea
options.explanation_md: The provision addresses limitation independently of that plea.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The provision addresses limitation independently of that plea.
